hypotheses.signal: Published injection minus a pre-release frozen forecast; lower is tighter.
hypotheses.requires: Timestamped independent consensus or our own frozen forecast and scale; five-year averages are context only.

hypotheses.signal: Change in population-weighted HDD and CDD over identical future dates.
hypotheses.requires: At least four common future dates across two archived forecast vintages; heating and cooling stay separate.

hypotheses.signal: Confirmed LNG outage or restart changes feedgas demand.
hypotheses.requires: Operator notice with publication and first-observed timestamps; direction checked against supply outages.

hypotheses.signal: Regional freeze-offs, pipeline maintenance and production recovery.
hypotheses.requires: Timestamped pipeline/producer notices and corroboration; weather headlines alone are insufficient.

hypotheses.signal: Curve shape, UNG roll exposure and implied move versus event response distribution.
hypotheses.requires: Point-in-time futures curve, options bid/ask and matched historical events; not yet connected.
